context.summary: Silver nanoparticles (Ag NPs) and silver-reduced graphene oxide nanocomposites (Ag/RGO NCs) green-synthesized with orange peel extract, tested for anticancer activity. The paper studies their physico-chemical characterization (UV-vis, XRD, TEM, SEM, EDS, DLS) and anticancer performance.

context.summary: Fucoxanthin, a carotenoid from brown algae, encapsulated in solid lipid nanoparticles (SLNs) made with coconut oil and eco-friendly surfactants, with enteric coating and freeze-drying.
